cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: 3-12 month deposits, but group-level ownership path and PRC subsidiary dividend friction are not proven.
cash_breakdown.reason: Presented as non-current assets due within one year, not cash equivalents.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Maturity over one year and not cash equivalents; use long-term deposit haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank loans and other loans are deducted at 100%; directors report a larger loans balance than the simple balance-sheet borrowing subtotal, so use the conservative larger amount.

profit_quality.assessment: 2025 operating cash flow was RMB5.796bn, well above parent net profit of RMB3.187bn, and 2023-2025 operating cash flow also covered profit. Main haircut reasons are large non-core financial/investment gains, need for continued manufacturing capex, and no disclosed maintenance/growth capex split.
adjustments: Use 2023-2025 net profits after deducting non-recurring items attributable to shareholders: RMB2.355bn, RMB2.606bn, RMB2.445bn; main pre-haircut value is the median RMB2.445bn.
Do not use reported 2025 parent net profit RMB3.187bn because the recurring-profit line is materially lower and investment/fair-value gains are significant.
Apply 0.85 profit haircut: cash conversion is good, but the business is manufacturing with capex and working-capital needs and 2025 includes investment gain RMB1.032bn and fair-value gain RMB0.231bn.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow / reported parent net profit in 2025 = 1.82x; 2023-2025 operating cash flow values disclosed were RMB10.612bn, RMB5.132bn and RMB5.796bn.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Good operating cash collection supports a high but not full factor; deduct/non-recurring profit line is used and then discounted for financial gains, capex and undisclosed maintenance capex split.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Strong in 2025 and across the disclosed three-year summary.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2025 capex was RMB2.114bn and 2024 capex RMB1.394bn; maintenance/growth split unavailable, so profit factor is capped below 0.90.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables, factoring receivables, inventories, notes/payables and discounts are large; annual cash conversion is good but liquidity reserve is still required.
